title: HelperFSWatchResult
description: Result of the helper fs service's watch op: the digest of the directory as the host observed it when the watch was installed. A caller holding the digest it last listed compares the two, so a change that landed while no subscription existed is still announced — the helper's baseline is now, and it will not announce that change again. The digest is the same computation `fs.list` answers (`filesystem.ComputeRev`), so the two are comparable without a second vocabulary.

rev.description: The digest of the whole, ordered directory at subscription time. Two callers comparing revs are comparing the same value a list would answer.
